name: trace_id
description: Parent trace id (FK to traces.trace_id).

name: step_id
description: Unique step id within a trace. PK together with trace_id.

name: parent_step_id
description: Parent step id for nested steps. Null at top level.

name: index
description: Ordered index among siblings.

name: project_id
description: Project the parent trace belongs to. Cluster column.

name: org_id
description: Org the parent project belongs to.

name: ingest_date
description: UTC date the parent trace was ingested. Partition column (DAY).

name: type
description: llm | tool | retrieval | robotics | human | annotation | custom.

name: name
description: Human-readable step name.

name: model
description: Model name for llm steps.

name: status
description: success | error | running | cancelled. Cluster column.

name: error_message
description: Step error message, if status = error.

name: started_at
description: Step start timestamp.

name: ended_at
description: Step end timestamp.

name: latency_ms
description: ended_at - started_at, in milliseconds.

name: input_tokens
description: Input tokens consumed by this step.

name: output_tokens
description: Output tokens emitted by this step.

name: cost_usd
description: Estimated step cost in USD.

name: message_count
description: Number of messages on this step.

name: tool_call_count
description: Number of tool_calls on this step.

name: attachment_count
description: Number of media attachments (images/audio/video/sensor/file).

name: modalities
description: Distinct modalities present: text, image, audio, video, sensor, file.

name: metadata
description: Free-form step metadata JSON.
